It is organized into sections such as 'Chicken', 'Beef', and 'Pork', each accompanied by small thumbnail images of the dishes. This is a common artifact in AI-generated documents.

The wood grain on the chopsticks appears slightly smudged and lacks the fine, sharp linear detail expected in a macro shot. The boundary between the chopstick rest and the table/menu edge is slightly soft.
The vertical alignment of the text columns wavers slightly near the right edge, not following a perfect geometric perspective line, suggesting minor warping.
